Tells the bus that a bus feeds. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
Print GetAudioBusParent(cave)
```
@param bus  A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error.
@returns The bus it feeds, `0` for the master bus (and for the master bus itself).
